name: LinkedIn
verdict: Signing in and posting as a member is self-serve and instant. Anything for company pages, mentions or analytics is an application LinkedIn can reject, and a rejected app cannot reapply.

creation.label: Easy
creation.note: Self-serve products are instant. Not tested by us.

approval.label: Partner-gated
approval.note: Community Management API: two reviews, no reapply after rejection.

handsOn.note: Minutes for member posting; days to prepare an application and screencast.

ownApp.headline: Check Composio first.
ownApp.note: Composio's guide warns that org actions return 403 unless your auth config requests organization scopes.

oneWayDoors.title: Rejection means a new app.
oneWayDoors.detail: If a Development or Standard tier request is rejected, you cannot reapply with the same app.
oneWayDoors.doThis: Prepare the application carefully the first time.

oneWayDoors.title: A page admin must verify your app.
oneWayDoors.detail: A super admin of the linked LinkedIn Page has to verify the app.
oneWayDoors.doThis: Line up the page admin before you apply.

items.name: Self-serve products
items.when: Sign In with LinkedIn (OIDC), Share on LinkedIn.
items.useFor: Sign-in and posting as a member

items.name: Community Management, Development tier
items.when: After an access request is approved.

items.name: Community Management, Standard tier
items.when: After a second review with a screencast.

scopes.intro: You can only request scopes your approved products grant. LinkedIn rejects the whole authorization if any requested scope is not granted.
changingLater: New scopes need the matching product approved first.
Functional changes may need re-review for Standard tier.

toCreate: LinkedIn app linked to a company page
forApproval: Standard tier: downloadable screencast of each use case

steps.title: Create the app and link a page
steps.detail: A page super admin verifies the app.

steps.title: Add self-serve products
steps.detail: Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect, Share on LinkedIn.

steps.title: Match auth config scopes to products
Draft the Development tier request
steps.detail: Use case, legal entity, business email, website, privacy policy.

steps.title: Build and record the Standard tier screencast
steps.detail: Show OAuth approval and each use case's test cases.

steps.title: Standard tier review
steps.detail: Rejection again means a new app.

approval.whenNeeded: Only for page, mention and analytics APIs.

ladder.limit: 60-day tokens, no refresh token; users re-consent.
Standard tier needs a second review.

notes.title: Marketing API version sunset
notes.text: Version 202511 sunsets Nov 16, 2026. Pin a current version.

rows.refresh: Stated 365 days, fixed from first grant

tokens.note: LinkedIn's example response shows refresh_token_expires_in of 525600 seconds (about 6 days), conflicting with the stated 365 days.

rules.title: Data storage requirements
rules.text: apply to Community Management apps and are checked in review.

blockers.cause: Requested a scope your products don't grant
Organization scopes not requested or not approved
blockers.fix: Get Community Management approval and request org scopes

blockers.cause: No refresh token for standard apps
blockers.fix: Prompt users to reconnect before expiry

evidence.claim: Two-tier review, no reapply after rejection
evidence.basis: Microsoft Learn: Community Management app review
